notes: Refute-first verify of all 36 NJ resolution rows. Sources opened and checked locally: (1) P.L.2024, c.16 chapter law HTML (official_link for 34 rows) — every statutory quote found verbatim after whitespace/quote normalization; (2) the Legislature's official codified STATUTES-TEXT.zip, downloaded fresh 2026-08-19 (last-modified 2026-08-19) — the full 47:1A-5 section was extracted, every statutory quote also matches the CODIFIED text, and the history line reads 'L.2001, c.404, s.6; amended 2010, c.75, s.5; ... 2023, c.113, s.2; 2024, c.16, s.2.' — independently confirming NO 2025 or 2026 amendment; (3) GRC Custodian's Handbook, opened, self-identifies 'Eighth Edition – January 2025' (post-amendment) — all Handbook quotes verbatim; (4) GRC Custodian's Toolkit, opened, 'First Edition March 2011' — template and postage quotes verbatim; (5) GRC official OPRA request form (2024-9-3) PDF, opened — payment-box and deposit/prepayment quotes verbatim (two-column layout interleaves lines; all quoted text present); (6) live GRC custodian FAQ page — waiver-discretion quote verbatim. Municipal scope: the enacted 47:1A-1.1 definition ('any political subdivision of the State... and any division, board, bureau, office, commission or other instrumentality within or created by a political subdivision') confirms all rows' applies_to=all_public_bodies; no agency-only figure was recorded as municipal. Resolution-word audit: the $0.05/$0.07 rate is 'shall be' (value, not ceiling); the commercial expedite is 'not exceeding 2x' (ceiling, correctly worded); special service charge/fee rows carry actual_cost_standard with no invented numbers; labor.overheadPct's 0 is a disclosed prohibition-zero derived from 'actual direct cost'/'no fringe benefits', not a quantified soft standard; the enacted text contains no actual-cost override sentence and no occurrence of 'overhead', confirming the P.L.2024, c.16 deletion. Rows resting partly on guidance (delivery, productionGate, depositClock, overheadPct, deposit.percent, color) already carry manual_verification flags in the raw file — kept as-is.
